about: Workshop imports the page answers with another file than the one they name. A row with `shell`: the web shell holds the newer copy of that Workshop module (it exports what the page and other Workshop tools ask of it). A row with `home`: the Workshop file imports a path its target no longer has, and `home` is where that file lives in the Workshop now. Each row ends when the Workshop catches up. Read by scripts/workshop-shell-imports.mjs.
